info.title: Bastion MCP (Health) Server
info.description:
Health endpoints for the Bastion Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. The MCP server supports both stdio and Streamable HTTP transports, providing 33 tools, 4 resources, and 3 prompts to AI agents.

Tools: `memory_search`, `memory_store`, `memory_timetravel`, `memory_audit`, `memory_heal`, `memory_delete`, `memory_pin`, `memory_get_pinned`, `memory_list`, `memory_correct`, `memory_health`, `memory_apply_patch`, `resolve_conflict`, `a2a_bridge`, `ltm_check_reuse`, `ltm_store_analysis`, `ltm_invalidate`, `dream`, `dream_history`, `detect_contradictions`, `scan_all_contradictions`, `detect_observations`, `multi_signal_search`, `context_pack`, `agent_schema`.

Resources: `bastion://schema`, `bastion://config`, `bastion://stats`, `bastion://memory/{memory_id}`.

This HTTP server provides health check endpoints for container orchestration and load balancers.

get.description: Returns 200 OK when the MCP server process is running.
Returns 200 OK when the MCP server is ready to process tool calls (DB connected or mock mode).

ApiKeyAuth.description: API key via `BASTION_API_KEY` environment variable. Send as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

x-mcp-tools.description: These tools are available via MCP stdio (subprocess) or Streamable HTTP transport. Agent frameworks connect to the MCP server via stdio or HTTP.

tools.name: memory_search
tools.description: C-SPANN vector search with decay-weighted scoring and trust scores.

tools.name: memory_store
tools.description: SHA-256 hash-chained storage with 1024-dim vector embeddings and OWASP guard screening.

tools.name: memory_timetravel
tools.description: AS OF SYSTEM TIME point-in-time queries for historical memory analysis.

tools.name: memory_audit
tools.description: Append-only immutable audit log with cryptographic hash chain verification.

tools.name: memory_heal
tools.description: CDC-triggered self-healing: prune expired memories, detect anomalies.

tools.name: memory_delete
tools.description: Delete memory by ID with confirmation flag. SERIALIZABLE isolation.

tools.name: memory_pin
tools.description: Pin safety rules with priority levels. Highest priority in search results.

tools.name: memory_get_pinned
tools.description: Retrieve all pinned memories with priority filtering.

tools.name: memory_list
tools.description: List memories with type filtering and pagination.

tools.name: memory_correct
tools.description: Update memory content. Governance tool for correcting stored information.

tools.name: memory_health
tools.description: Return memory health metrics: count, freshness, access patterns.

tools.name: memory_apply_patch
tools.description: RFC 6902 JSON Patch on memory metadata. Atomic apply-or-nothing.

tools.name: resolve_conflict
tools.description: Multi-agent conflict resolution with SERIALIZABLE isolation.

tools.name: a2a_bridge
tools.description: Retrieve A2A Agent Card for inter-agent discovery.

tools.name: ltm_check_reuse
tools.description: Check if similar analysis already exists (LTM Gateway).

tools.name: ltm_store_analysis
tools.description: Store completed analysis for future reuse.

tools.name: ltm_invalidate
tools.description: Mark cached analyses as stale when new info arrives.

tools.name: dream
tools.description: Sleep-time memory consolidation and deduplication.

tools.name: dream_history
tools.description: Retrieve consolidation history.

tools.name: detect_contradictions
tools.description: Scan for contradictions against a stored memory.

tools.name: scan_all_contradictions
tools.description: Batch contradiction scan across all memories.

tools.name: detect_observations
tools.description: Detect recurring themes and entity clusters.

tools.name: multi_signal_search
tools.description: 4-signal fusion: vector + keyword + entity + temporal.

tools.name: context_pack
tools.description: Token-budget packing for LLM context injection.

tools.name: agent_schema
tools.description: DB schema introspection for agent tables.
